mapper.select: SELECT u.id, i.provider_user_id AS login_id, u.nickname FROM users u LEFT JOIN auth_identities i ON i.user_id = u.id AND i.provider = 'LOCAL' WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.priority, p.success_criteria, p.estimated_minutes, p.carried_improvement, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM plans p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT r.id, r.plan_id, r.revision_no, r.title, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.priority, r.success_criteria, r.estimated_minutes, r.carried_improvement, r.revised_at FROM plan_revisions r JOIN plans p ON p.id = r.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.plan_id, t.title, t.due_date, t.priority, t.estimated_minutes, t.status, t.completion_cycle, t.completed_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM todos t JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE ORDER BY t.id ASC
SELECT g.id, g.user_id, g.name, g.normalized_name, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM tags g WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.id ASC

SELECT tt.todo_id, tt.tag_id, tt.created_at FROM todo_tags tt JOIN todos t ON t.id = tt.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id JOIN tags g ON g.id = tt.tag_id WHERE AND g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY tt.todo_id ASC, tt.tag_id ASC

SELECT e.id, e.todo_id, NULL AS todo_title, e.started_at, e.ended_at, e.actual_minutes, e.blocker_reason, e.created_at FROM execution_logs e JOIN todos t ON t.id = e.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE ORDER BY e.id ASC
SELECT c.id, c.todo_id, c.idempotency_key, c.cycle_no, c.completed_at, c.created_at FROM completion_events c JOIN todos t ON t.id = c.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT r.id, r.todo_id, r.revision_no, r.title, r.due_date, r.priority, r.estimated_minutes, r.tag_names, r.revised_at FROM todo_revisions r JOIN todos t ON t.id = r.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE ORDER BY r.id ASC
SELECT e.id, e.todo_id, e.cycle_no, e.reopened_at, e.created_at FROM reopen_events e JOIN todos t ON t.id = e.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE ORDER BY e.id ASC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.plan_id, r.period_start, r.period_end, r.improvement, r.next_plan_id, r.transferred_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reviews r JOIN plans p ON p.id = r.plan_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.id ASC
